intro: Darkhound Blood is a foul bodily fluid harvested from the tainted canine beasts roaming the fields and forests of Tirisfal Glades. Gathered at the behest of the Royal Apothecary Society, it serves as an early reagent in their dark experiments to engineer a lethal new plague.

p: Under the command of Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, the Royal Apothecary Society strives to develop a virulent contagion capable of wiping out Arthas and his Scourge. Stationed in Brill, Apothecary Johaan theorizes that local beasts, corrupted by dark energies and resilient to the surrounding decay, possess unusual biological properties. By distilling the blood of wild darkhounds, Johaan aims to uncover biological compounds that can resist or propagate virulent necrotic strains.
